answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 39 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in cedar, queued in violet, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 317 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3375 identities would post 2795 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
